prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one small 2D skeletal-animation boot component
Primary request: Create exactly one dark navy magical-girl ankle boot as a clean game-sprite component. The cuff points upper-right. The toe points lower-left, screen-left, and slightly downward. This is the boot for the rear leg of a three-quarter side-view combat pose.
Shape: one connected silhouette with a short V-shaped cuff, fitted ankle, compact gently pointed toe, thin dark sole, and short block heel. Add one small violet diamond-shaped gem fixed to the front of the ankle and one tiny gold diamond fixed directly beneath it. Add a narrow plain dark insertion tab rising from inside the cuff by 15 percent of the boot height for overlap with a separately animated lower leg.
Rendering: restrained flat 2D cel art. Use a closed cool-dark contour and four local color groups only: dark navy base, indigo shadow, one hard pale-violet highlight plane, and purple heel. Use hard transitions rather than gradients. Treat the violet gem as ordinary colored glass with no emitted light. Every visible mark must belong to the physical boot, fixed ornaments, or insertion tab, and the physical silhouette must have a crisp closed edge.
Composition/framing: exactly one boot centered on a vertical 2:3 canvas. The complete physical shape occupies about 38 percent of canvas width and 48 percent of canvas height. Keep wide unused margins on all four sides. Show the full cuff, insertion tab, toe, sole, and heel without cropping.
Constraints: no reference sheet, second boot, pair, duplicate, alternate view, leg, knee, thigh, foot skin, body, clothing beyond the boot, hand, weapon, spell, detached ornament, extra accessory, aura, glow, bloom, rim lighting, backlighting, luminous edge, soft edge, feathering, gradient field, haze, fog, smoke, particles, shadow, floor, scenery, text, logo, signature, or watermark. No sprite sheet, atlas, turnaround, grid, panel, inset, or multiple views.
